about: Node60 power shapes, stage 1 (2026-11-04): inner planes (D12-1/D17 A), the 60 A entry path on B, In2, In3 and the F band (D18 A), VBAT_PROT at the disconnect FETs' sources, GND pours, and via fields at 0.65 A per 0.45/0.25 mm via (D12-6). Stage 2: each switch's VBB pad gets in-pad vias (filled and capped, DEC-027); each output a pour on B and F from its pins to its header's pin 1, OUTb the mirror image of OUTa, with mirrored via fields so both outputs of a switch get the same copper. D19 A (2026-11-04): the cells' small parts moved clear of the OUT exits; the B output pours reach north to y 104.5 beside the pins (F stays south of the VBAT_IN bar area). D20 A (2026-11-04): both battery terminals VBAT_IN, the entry mirrored about x 155. D21 C (2026-11-04): rows swapped so the ideal-diode FETs sit beside U201 (short DGATE): VBAT_IN an L from each ring to its north-row FET on B and In2 (In3 stays VBAT_PROT under it, toward U601/U801), VBAT_D the north band around the U201/U202 column, VBAT_Q2D the south band, VBAT_PROT from the south-row sources; vias in all four FET tabs. In3 VBAT_PROT (2026-11-04): the user cut it from the whole board to the power band; in3_sweep.py found the knee at x 72-238, y 71-122 (south of the switches carries current; the north and the far ends little). Small rails (D22 A and D23, 2026-11-04): 3V3_MAIN on In3 north of y 70.8, a 1V5_CORE island on In3 from U401's core to R303, VBAT_PROT fingers on In3 to L201 and U301, VBAT_FILT on B from L201 to U302; one via per small-rail pad (in the pad where it fits), U401's power and ground balls dogboned. Under U401 every via is 0.35/0.20 mm (via_overrides) so In3 keeps 0.15 mm webs; the caps under it sit on via pairs posed by power/bga_decaps.py (blocks/u401_decaps.poses.json), its power and ground balls dogboned at the cells that script chose (prefer, strict); H7 joins H6 on B, and C403, C404 and C419 reach their vias by short F tracks. D24 (2026-11-05): U302's cell re-composed (U302 turned 180 degrees, its passives mirrored about the chip's east-west axis: on B the cell had been seated as TI's top-view figure, so SW pin 7 faced away from L301); L201, C206, C207, C217 and the VBAT_FILT test points follow the input caps south, the L201 finger on In3 moves to x 115-119, y 59-71; both bucks' hot-loop copper on B (VBAT_FILT, SW, the REG output node, 3V3 at U303) and GND vias in every buck cap's GND pad and U302's exposed pad. D25 A (2026-11-05): a GND ring at 5 mm, 1 mm in from the edge; the interior stitching after routing. D26 A (2026-11-05): RMII and MDIO routed (rmii/route_rmii.sh, locked copper); In3's 3V3 plane and 1V5 island take a 0.12 mm minimum width so the 0.15 mm webs between U401's vias survive every refill. D32 I and H (2026-11-12): the thin 3V3 tracks into the power band are gone but U202's and U203's: R601 and R801 stand at the In3 margins' vias, R701 and the NTC pull-ups R607/R707/R807 on the plane south of U401, C215, R211, R406 and R407 at U203, R508 at U401 ball B3, each on its own via (points and stubs named D32; excepted from the automatic pad vias); a VBAT_IN pour on F.Cu joins the TVS D201's tab to the bar's pour. Routing run 2026-11-12 (D33 B): the routed board's supply joins are in the 'D33 B routing' groups; the In3 VBAT_PROT finger to U301 widened beside Q501 and Q502; four field vias beside R201's S1 pad removed for RS_SENSE_N (keep_clear). Not redrawn: draw_power.py is for an unrouted board. D36 A (2026-11-12): U201 pin 2 reaches VBAT_IN through the In2 finger PWR_VBAT_IN_U201_In2.
